faq1.question: How long does website development take?
faq1.answer: Development time depends on project complexity. Simple websites (up to 5 pages) are usually completed within 7-14 days, while more advanced sites, user accounts or integrations can take 3-6 weeks.

faq2.question: What does graphic design include?
faq2.answer: We offer logo design, visual identity (colors, typography), promotional materials (posters, flyers), social media design, packaging design and print preparation. We can also include mockups and examples of design implementation in real situations.

faq3.question: Do you develop web applications, not just websites?
faq3.answer: Yes, we specialize in custom web applications that include user accounts, data management, booking systems, CRM solutions and more. We use modern technologies like Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Prisma, React, and others.

faq4.question: Can you help with website maintenance?
faq4.answer: Yes, we offer maintenance packages that include security updates, backups, content additions and technical support.

faq5.question: What access control systems do you offer?
faq5.answer: We work with reliable solutions like Sebury devices (keyboards, card readers, RFID/NFC systems, Mobile App) and integrate them into your existing infrastructure.

faq6.question: What does the collaboration process look like?
faq6.answer:
The process usually goes like this:
1. Initial meeting either online (MS Teams, Google Meet, ...) or in person – we define your goals and needs
2. Proposal and agreement – we create a proposal and plan
3. Development – design, development and testing
4. Delivery and support – final review and support after delivery

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introduction: This website uses cookies to ensure you get the best experience on our website.

whatAreCookies.title: What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are pieces of information stored on your computer, mobile phone or tablet, which can be delivered directly by the website you visit (first-party cookies) or in collaboration for the needs of third parties (third-party cookies). Cookies typically store your settings, website settings, etc. After you reopen the website, your internet browser returns the cookies that belong to that page. This allows the page to display information tailored to your needs.

whichCookiesWeUse.title: Which cookies do we use?
whichCookiesWeUse.content: The cookies we use on this website are divided into the following categories:

necessary.title: Necessary cookies
necessary.content: These cookies are necessary for the proper functioning of the website. They enable basic functions such as page navigation and access to secure areas of the website. The website cannot function properly without these cookies.

statistics.title: Statistical cookies
statistics.content: These cookies help website owners understand how visitors communicate with websites by collecting and reporting information anonymously.

marketing.title: Marketing cookies
marketing.content: Marketing cookies are used to track visitors across websites. The intention is to display ads that are relevant and interesting to individual users and are therefore valuable to publishers and third party advertisers.

uncategorized.title: Uncategorized cookies
uncategorized.content: Uncategorized cookies are cookies that we are in the process of classifying, together with the providers of individual cookies.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect information that you voluntarily provide to us when you contact us via the contact form, including your name, email address, phone number and description of your project.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.content: We use your data exclusively to respond to your inquiries and provide our services. We will not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties without your consent.
